characteristics.name: Attack Attribute
characteristics.$text: The Strength, Armour Penetration, and additional Attack Attributes are defined in brackets (X).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The unit gains Solitary.
If it fails a Break Test, replace each model of the unit with a Wretched One model:
  • The unit and its models are considered removed as a casualties.
  • Each Wretched One model is placed in the same position and facing the same direction as the model it replaces (even if the replaced model was in contact with an enemy unit: in this case, the Wretched One model is placed in contact with the enemy unit, too).
  • The Wretched One models form a new unit.
  • The Wretched One unit follows the rules for Summoned Units, except that it ignores the Unit Spacing rule when placed on the Battlefield, but can still not overlap other units or Impassable Terrain.
  • The Wretched One unit cannot perform any Combat Reforms in the Round of Combat during which it is Summoned. Enemy units can do so as normal.
  • Note that the following Round of Combat is not considered the First Round of Combat for the Wretched One unit, nor for the enemy units it is Engaged with.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: After using this Breath Attack, the model loses a Health Point (with no saves of any kind allowed).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: Ignore all the Weapon Enchantments, Armour Enchantments and Shield Enchantments in units that are in contact with the bearer, including his own, for as long as the units remain in contact with the bearer.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Charge Range and Pursue Distance rolls by units containing this Favour are Maximised.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
During Pre-game Selections, mark a point on the Battlefield with a Gateway Marker: it must be within 24" of your Deployment Zone, outside the opponent’s Deployment Zone, and more than 1" from any Impassable Terrain.
There can never be more than 4 friendly Gateway Markers on the Battlefield.
If a Gateway Marker is removed, all units within 3" of the marker then suffer 3D3 hits with Toxic Attacks.
Remove all friendly Gateway Markers if there are no friendly Hellmaws or friendly models with a Veilgate Orb on the Battlefield, at the end of any phase.

At the start of each friendly Magic Phase, if this model was allowed to move during the preceding Movement Phase (ie. it is not shaken, did not Ambush, Fail Charge, is Unengaged etc.), you can apply one of the following effects:
  • Mark a single point on the Battlefield within 24" of the model with a Gateway Marker, and more than 1" from Impassable Terrain.
Before doing so, you may remove from the Battlefield a friendly Gateway Marker that was not placed during this Player Turn.
  • Target a single friendly unit within 9" of the model, not containing any model of Height 5, and that was allowed to move in the preceding Movement Phase (i.e. it is not shaken, did not Ambush, Fail Charge, is Unengaged etc.). Remove the unit from the Battlefield and immediately place it back on the Battlefield, in the same formation, with Ambush (friendly Gateway Marker, that was not placed during this Player Turn).

characteristics.name: Abilities
characteristics.$text: One use only. Can be activated during Combat Choices: the bearer gains +1 Att, +1 Str, and +1 AP, with Duration: Round of Combat.

characteristics.name: Artefact

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text: Before rolling the Random Movement distance in the Movement Phase, friendly units entirely with Irredeemable within 18" of the bearer may choose to apply either Minimised or Maximised to the roll.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Devastating Charge (Strider) and Feigned Flight.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: During Pre-game Selections, each Exalted Herald model part must choose two different Manifestations from the list below, and select two spells out of those indicated in the selected Manifestations, Wrath of God (Thaumaturgy), and Hellfire (Hereditary Spell) (this replaces the normal rules for Spell Selection connected to being a Wizard Adept).

characteristics.name: Rule

characteristics.name: Rule

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Disciplined.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
While the model is on the Battlefield, friendly units cannot use Fly for Move Manoeuvres or Charge Moves.
In addition, if the model is the General, the maximum sum of Legendary Beasts values in the army is increased by 1.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
One use only. Duration: End of Turn.
Can be activated at the start of any friendly Player Turn: the unit gains +2 Mob and Devastating Charge (+1 Att, +1 Str).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model gains Aegis (6+).
In addition, if the model is Height 1--4 it gains Aegis (+1, max. 4+, against no Armour Save*).
*Can only be used for attacks against which the model cannot take or would automatically fail its Armour Saves.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Shield.
When a Height 1--3 model is using a Hand Weapon and is Using a Spiked Shield simultaneously, and the bearer successfully passes an Armour Save roll of 4+ against a Melee Attack from an enemy model Engaged in its Front Facing, the bearer immediately inflicts 1 hit with the bearers Str and AP and Automatic Hits towards the Health Pool of the model that caused the wound, before any casualties are removed.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
+1 Str, Multiple Wounds (D3, towards Height 4--5).
The wielder is an Attachable Model, gains Exclusive (Barbarians) and loses Solitary.
No more than a single model with Tribal Warspear can ever be joined to the same unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
The model may take a single Banner Enchantment (using the bearer's Special Item allowance as normal).
In addition, the first time an Enemy unit engaged with the bearer’s unit is removed as a casualty, including all Attached Models, the bearer gains Resolute.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The Caster gains +1 to cast Learned Spells with type: Damage.

characteristics.name: Artefact
characteristics.$text:
During Pre-game Selections, mark a point on the Battlefield with a Gateway Marker: it must be within 24" of your Deployment Zone, outside the opponent’s Deployment Zone, and more than 1" from Impassable Terrain.
One use only. At the start of a friendly Magic Phase, if the bearer’s unit was allowed to move in the preceding Movement Phase (ie. it is not Shaken, did not Ambush, did not fail a Charge, is Unengaged, etc.), you may remove it from the Battlefield and immediately place it back on the Battlefield with Ambush (friendly Gateway Marker, that was not placed during this Player Turn).

characteristics.name: Banner Enchant
characteristics.$text:
The bearer’s unit gains First Strike (Flaming Attacks) and Strider (Ruins).
In addition, during Pre-game Selections, you can select a single Field or Forest: that was not placed during Pre-game selections, the selected Terrain Feature is changed to a Ruins, without changing size, with Duration: Permanent.

characteristics.name: Potions and Scrolls

The bearer’s model gains Hard Target (2).
